title: Taking, Asking, Helping, Loving
label: ch:la-doing-verbs
canDo: I can say I take, I ask, I help and I love in Latin, produce the he-or-she form of each, and name the English words each verb built.

payoff.summary: The chapter closes on amō: after learning it the reader produces all four first-person forms and all four third-person forms in sequence — capiō, rogō, adiuvō, amō and capit, rogat, adiuvat, amat.
